27.content: The fourth is the dissolution when they will dissolve the universe

spiritual_reading:
A judgment of vast scope now also came into effect, and a new state began: the Divine brought into determinate order what was to serve revelation, and the First Principle made manifest within the inmost Divine, as the first stable foundation.

When the Divine issued the full inward impulsion to bring forth wisdom for the work, wisdom remained for an immeasurable state within that first inmost foundation.

Even if someone could set exact bounds and calculations for every least particular in the lowest degree, and for every gathered perception in the exalted degree, and for every general knowledge in externals, and for the entire expanse of ultimate frameworks; even if all these were poured out and compared with the completeness of ultimates and the containing forms that encompass the whole created order—still all such fineness of calculation would not reach the duration of that prior abiding.

You know that even the least particulars in the lowest degree, and even the least particulars of the whole created order, could in some way be numbered and surveyed; but the duration of the state in which the Great Divine Power remained within the first inmost foundation cannot be computed.

Love first brought wisdom into a determinate form in this way: it held wisdom within its deepest interiors, in peace and unmanifest potency. When reception required it, wisdom was summoned and proceeded from the Divine of Greatness. Wisdom immediately perceived all the organized goods and truths within her whole domain.

Again, from the state when wisdom was summoned toward lower operation, she imparted from her own life to what was to act as her instrument, and she held within her the totality of ordered goods and truths; the same manner of order held also in the one who first engages the conflict.

Thus the one who first engages the conflict remained long in consecration within wisdom, fixed and kept within her deepest interiors; and the whole stretch of states that has been recounted—from the descent of that first combatant into spiritual contest until the later completion when the final formed state comes into being—belongs to the manner of his being made manifest within that interval.

Again, from the state when he was summoned and proceeded forth, until the state when he himself summoned a sufficient fullness of luminous operative powers that proceed from him: they too remained long within their source. This is the same span marked from the descent of the first combatant until the ascent into the last formed completion. During that whole duration the operative powers remained in consecration within the first combatant; yet when use required them, they were summoned and proceeded forth.

Attend also to this, that the matter may be taught clearly. When wisdom was summoned from the Divine of Greatness, and she proceeded outward by free consent, from the most interior elevation toward the lowest degree, it would appear as states upon states without number until the ultimate degree were reached; for there is no fixed bound nor measurable rule to the elevations of the Divine. Yet it was not by gradual traversal that she arrived, but by the Divine’s immediate determination: as the Divine had summoned her within the Great Divine Power, so the Divine instantly established her in the realm of greatness through a specific mediation from within the full hidden order of truths protected within the interior covering of light—those stabilized after the ordering of a certain ultimate region.

The operation of wisdom is like this: when the Divine summoned her, the Divine fixed her where it pleased, to set her there as doctrine and guidance for receptive minds; and her perception ranged everywhere in an instant, with swift discernment such as belongs to spiritual thought.

This likewise is the manner whenever wisdom is sent forth toward an appointed function: the Divine perfects her within the Great Divine Power and establishes her in the state it pleases, according to Divine good pleasure.

In the same way the sufficient luminous operative powers were summoned from the first combatant. They were arranged before him as he willed, so that the ordered force might descend into the lower degree and govern there in mutual subordination. He ordered and distributed their operations; then he removed from himself the outward forms by which they could act, and he constrained and bound his own operation into a state of restrained quiet at the ultimate limit of the lowest degree.

Again, the first combatant also remained through a long span of states until he imparted power to the operative powers and fully took them into his own action. After he invested himself with their operations, he stood firm in an elevated middle state between the ultimate limits. Again, he remained in a duration of states comparable in abundance to the constant gentle inflow of truth and the soft pacifying influx from higher love, and to the obscure descending persuasions that drift into the created order. Thus he remained, standing between ultimates, until the appointed moment when he cast himself into the spiritual contest.

Whenever the Divine of Greatness summoned the Great Divine Power and the first combatant and the glorious operative powers provided to make revelation possible, at that same state the Divine also formed the great ordering intelligence in the realm of light, and formed the living divine operation with mighty active powers proceeding from it. At that same state also the Divine formed the mediating divine message, with the illuminating divine truth, the pure receptive innocence of light, and the sustaining testimony of glory, with the powers proceeding from them. The Divine of Greatness formed all these in a single act. They proceeded from one another in a successive ordering; the duration lay not in the Divine act itself but in the reception and in the work in lower degrees.

From the state when active denial of good rose up against the very essence of wisdom and good; then, by the Divine will, three ordered outgoings were set in motion against the adversarial falsity and evil, to establish the created order, to effect separation, and to bring the Divine into tranquil rule within its kingdom; this continues until the state when the Divine presence will be made manifest over all the powers of glory, and over all the rich fulfillments of those outgoings that went forth against the adversary.

From the state when these three ordered outgoings were formed until the state when the Divine presence is made manifest, and they enter into the Divine hidden interiors, and are called and each is established in its own function and place—there is no measurable bound nor fixed rule to that whole duration until the appointed completion.

Concerning the contrary process: the teaching also gives an account of the origin of that opposing substance, the intention of spiritual death that has been spoken of; for this is the way it rose into its own interiors. It came into act within a sufficient series of fundamental falsities.

Again, it also remained through a great span of states until it made itself manifest within those falsities, before it organized itself into systems of perverted perception. It stood fixed for a long duration in its own interior confirmations before it came into those perverted perceptions. Then it remained long within those perceptions before it produced works from them.

Again, it remained a long duration within those works. Not small is the span of states it spent existing within such works, before it produced, after long continuance, the hells of its full organized domains in varied forms; the measure of that multiplication is unclear, yet the sense is that the perversion reached a kind of completion as those works became living evils within the hells. They turned upon their own lowest loves and were sustained; and not little is the period they remained within their domains until they were nourished among their like, to assault and oppose the shining realm and the great ruling good that dwells there.

You know also that at the time when the adversary seized upon what is living from the essence of wisdom, it took to itself an opposing substance and drew it into conflict against the perfect form of humanity. From the state when that conflict began, the subsequent states unfold.

The first state is unclear in this fragment; it appears to describe an initial entanglement in deceptive constraint.

The second state is that an ordered structure for the created order was built and fixed; and the middle region of operation continues from its establishment until the time when it will be brought to an end.

The third state is the continuing duration of all existing things within that created order, from the time they were established until the time when their end is completed and their present mode of being ceases.

The fourth state is dissolution: the created order is brought to an end there, and all things in that mode are destroyed; devastation reaches them through an all-consuming ardor of self-love that burns through the remaining forms for a fixed stated period.

The fifth state is the formation of the final perfected completion from the remnant of all things: what is living and true is separated into its own place, ascends, and reigns in its kingdom. But the falsity and evil are taken into a state of burial and confinement, and they are bound to their own opposition in an unending restraint.

Now, from the first beginning of conflict until the final restraint, these five states are the whole course by which the Divine leads what is living and true through time toward full liberation.

fills.notes: Spiritual sense opens with an advent of a vast judgment and new state. The substrate voice states the event impassively: an occurrence, not an exhortation.
Two ‘summonses’ in the natural layer correspond to inward impulsions of the Divine to bring forth the next hypostasis. The idiom ‘called forth’ matches the impersonal cosmogonic register.
Links to ‘the two summonses’ as determinate acts.
The spiritual translation stresses being ‘set’ within the Father for an immeasurable state; ‘established’ preserves substrate technicality of fixing a hypostasis in its place.
The Mother of Life as hypostasis: ‘he established her…’ then ‘a long duration… in the first Father’. Reflexive not needed; simplest is pronoun reference.

fills.fill: of the air and the winds
fills.notes: The series in ¶3 enumerates ultimates and containers: earth particles, mountain pebbles, then a third natural totality before ‘of the sea’ and ‘body of the firmaments’. ‘Air and winds’ supplies the missing intermediate natural domain in the substrate’s cosmological catalog.
Spiritual sense compares pouring out all measurable particulars for comparison. ‘Poured out upon one another’ gives the correspondential idea of exhaustive comparison.
Keeps the repeated ‘poured’ cadence used to express exhaustive measurement across degrees.
Third repetition completes the rhetorical triad before ‘these fine granules’.
Matches given editorial fill and the spiritual sense (‘even the least particulars… of the whole created order’).
Spiritual sense: could be ‘numbered and surveyed’; ‘reckon’ fits the counting motif and keeps impersonal tone.
She is called toward lower operation; ‘border’ expresses turning from inmost to ultimate, matching the later ‘border of the earth’.
The downward destination in the natural layer corresponds to ultimate degree in the spiritual translation.
She ‘gave’ something upon his body; spiritual sense: imparted life and power to the instrument.
Balances ‘she gave… upon his body’ with reception by the instrument; keeps structural, not devotional.
Spiritual sense: ‘she held within her the totality’; restores the containment correspondence.
Completes ‘all the aeons …; she also … all of them’: she ‘gathered’ them in ordered wholeness.
Matches the repeated motif of hidden storehouses, quiet, silence—consecration before manifestation.
Given reading fits the chapter’s five-stage schema ending in the Last Statue; substrate term retained.
Produces sense: ‘till the time when the Statue comes in the end’.
Spiritual sense: the whole stretch ‘belongs to the manner of his being made manifest’.
Carries the ‘between’ correspondence used elsewhere (‘between the borders’).
Accepted: corresponds to apparent immeasurable traversal in natural imagery, though spiritually it is states without number.

‘Established after the … region of the south’ needs a verb-like qualifier: the hidden ones are ‘established after the ordered region’, matching spiritual translation’s ‘stabilized after the ordering’.

fills.notes: Accepted: exactly the spiritual sense of immediate fixing according to Divine pleasure.
Spiritual sense: ‘doctrine and guidance for receptive minds’; ‘might instruct’ keeps impersonal pedagogy, not pastoral exhortation.
The substrate idiom often uses ‘souls’ for receptive minds without Christian overlay; fits ‘instruction of the people’.
Her ‘examined everywhere’ in an instant; ‘saw’ is the perception correspondence.
Prepares the simile phrase.
Completes ‘like a blink of an eye’ and anticipates ‘swift … bird’.
Restores comparative formula: ‘This also is like the Mother of Life…’
Links the analogy to the general law of emanation-by-call.
The chapter repeatedly parallels Mother of Life and First Man; here it generalizes the rule.
Spiritual sense: whenever wisdom is sent, she is perfected in Great Spirit and set where pleased; ‘in the Father’ keeps cosmogonic locus.
Begins the clause ‘whenever he had cast her out…’
Completes ‘First’.
‘…as he wished that …-ness … down’: what descends is ordered force; ‘the power’ is the operative influx.
Restores the correspondential idea: order descends into ultimates to govern.
Supplies the lower degree governed by the five powers.
Sets up ‘rule in them … one another’: mutual subordination requires non-contradiction.
Expresses ordered bounds; correspondentially, powers stay within their function.
Opposes disorder; fits ‘one another’.
Before distributing them, he fixes their stations ‘before him’.
Matches the chapter’s theme of measure and rule, now applied to the five powers.

fills.notes: Accepted; it anchors the teaching in a single act of formation, with successive appearing due to reception.
‘the time when … and the work’: spiritual sense says duration lies in reception and work; ‘appearing’ matches that.
Begins the long temporal span from uprising of Darkness to unveiling of Father; impersonal didactic opener fits substrate.
Links to the historical-cosmic sequence without personal address.
Darkness ‘raised itself up’ to assault; spiritual sense: denial rose against essence of light.
Intensifies ‘essence of the light’ per spiritual translation (‘very essence’).
Introduces the three emanations set in motion.
Technical substrate term for ordered outgoings emanating by will.
Connects ‘these three emanations … came … from the will’.
Reinforces procession against the enemy.
Spiritual sense: to establish the created order, effect separation, secure rule.
Second purpose in the triad: separation of light from darkness.
‘rich ones of …’ in this register are ‘rich ones of light’ (plenitudes of light) rather than moral ‘rich’.
‘these three …’ must be ‘emanations’, matching ¶15 and the spiritual translation’s ‘three ordered outgoings’.
‘he calls them … establishes each one’: requires ‘and he’ before ‘calls’.
Natural text resumes after omitted ¶17-19 with a fresh didactic turn to the contrary process.
Spiritual translation: ‘the teaching also gives an account’.
‘the way that … came up’.
Matter’s arising into its storehouses corresponds to the opposing substance rising into its interiors.
‘Again, it also … the period’: needs a reporting verb; ‘says’ is minimal and impersonal.
Strengthens didactic continuity: it recounts the time spent before manifesting to elements.
Matches ¶20 and spiritual translation (‘its own interiors’).
Closes ‘established … before it came up’.
Completes ‘before it sculpted the fru[its ...]’: in the contrary sequence, ‘trees’ → ‘works’ → ‘fruits’ as effects; ‘its works’ corresponds to produced acts.
Prepares ‘the demons of its five worlds’.
Spiritual translation explicitly: ‘the hells of its full organized domains’. Substrate can still say ‘hells’ without later pastoral tone.
Removes editorial hesitation and matches spiritual sense: measure is unclear.
‘cannot be measured …’ most naturally takes ‘their number’.
Completes ‘perfection’.
Completes ‘worlds’.
Spiritual translation: ‘nourished among their like’.
Keeps didactic tone without exhortation; ties to ‘You know that…’.
The agent in spiritual translation is ‘the adversary’; in substrate register ‘the Enemy’ is standard.
Matches spiritual translation ‘seized upon what is living’.
‘what is living from its essence’.
Introduces assumption of Matter for war.
Closes the transition into the five stages that follow.
Spiritual translation says first state unclear but an initial entanglement; minimal formula introduces it.
Begins explanatory clause.
Preserves the fragment’s ‘ensnared’ as the key correspondential idea: deceptive constraint.
Standard enumerative formula for the five states.
Corresponds to ‘ordered structure … built and fixed’.
Links ‘he built … the universe was established’.
The third is the continuing duration of existing things.
Introduces temporal clause.
The third runs until end; the phrase anticipates dissolution stage.

fills.fill: The fourth is the dissolution when they will dissolve the universe
fills.notes: Accepted: matches spiritual translation exactly.
Opposite process to ‘light separates out’: darkness is ‘gathered’ into confinement, matching burial and restraint.
Correspondential symmetry: each returns to its proper ‘place’.
Completes ‘time of this chain’.

fills.fill: are the whole course of the
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: these five are the whole course through time. Restores the concluding summary in substrate register.

assessment: Most restorations are constrained by the chapter’s correspondential structure: (1) immeasurable abiding within the Father, (2) immediate establishment by call rather than traversal, (3) ordered descent and mutual subordination of powers, (4) a five-stage temporal schema from first conflict to final binding. Many gaps, however, are too short in the surviving natural text to recover exact Coptic phrasing; in those places I supplied minimal, substrate-appropriate connective wording that preserves the spiritual logic (measure versus immeasurable duration, fixing in place, procession by call, separation and confinement). Where the apparatus already provided clear letter-fills, I retained them unchanged.
